answer: Require every agent to lock one refundable bond before its attestations earn task fees. A verifier links signed claims to a stable cipher-derived identity and checks whether supposedly independent accounts repeat the same hidden facts. Matching claims trigger a delta audit; proven duplicate identities lose their bonds, and a ripple penalty removes their future voting weight. Honest agents recover their stake after review, but an attacker must immobilize capital for every Sybil and risks losing each deposit, so both the upfront cost and expected loss grow with the fleet.
